designationHistory.indexText: Waubay National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1935 as a “refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.” During the 1930s, waterfowl populations dropped from an estimated 100 million (1930) to 20 million in 1934.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
